criteria.notes: NOT A TRAP, reported separately, two items. (1) The edge-case note - 'closure of any braid containing a full twist Delta_n^2 in the centre acquires a factor q^{n(n-1)} from the central character' - is not right as a uniform scalar. I computed Delta_3^2 = (sigma_0 sigma_1)^3 in H_3(q) symbolically: it is a genuine six-term element, not q^6 times the identity. Being central it acts by a scalar on each Wedderburn block, but that scalar is lambda-dependent: q^{n(n-1)} = q^6 on the trivial rep (sigma_i -> q) and q^{-6} on the sign rep (sigma_i -> -q^-1). The claim holds for the trivial block only. (2) The codomain is given as R[q, q^-1], but the Markov parameter is a rational function of q under either convention (D: z = q^3/(q^2+1)), so bare tr_M lands in R(q); Laurent-polynomiality is a property of the normalised Jones invariant, not of the raw trace.
